overviewParagraphs: Mission Hills Golf Club Phuket holds a unique distinction on the island — it is the only course where the Andaman Sea appears as a genuine backdrop to multiple holes, making it the closest thing to true ocean-front golf that Phuket offers. Jack Nicklaus's design responds to this advantage intelligently, routing the back nine along the coastline to maximise sea exposure on approach shots and from elevated tee positions.

The course quality is world-class, with bentgrass greens, well-defined fairway corridors, and premium conditioning that matches Phuket's most celebrated facilities. Nicklaus's strategic philosophy of rewarding proper positioning over raw distance plays out across all 18 holes, making it a course where course management determines scores as much as ball-striking.

For discerning golfers who want Phuket's premium oceanfront experience alongside championship-standard golf, Mission Hills Phuket is the definitive answer. AGS pairs it with Red Mountain and Blue Canyon for a complete Phuket golf trilogy that showcases the full range of what the island offers.

curatorBriefHtml: Mission Hills Phuket Golf Resort (opened 2004 by Jack Nicklaus on Phuket’s quiet northeast coast, just 15 minutes from Phuket International Airport) is Phuket’s only course set directly beside the Andaman Sea mangroves and coastline. Stretching to 7,005 yards (Par 72), the layout is immediately recognizable for its gleaming bright-white crushed-coral sand bunkers and dramatic coastal par 3s framed by ocean breezes.

Having played Mission Hills Phuket personally, it is best viewed as a scenic, breezy coastal complement to Phuket’s heavier hitters — offering wide, forgiving landing corridors, sweeping Phang Nga Bay views on the signature waterfront holes, and an ultra-short 15-minute airport transfer.
AGS pairs Mission Hills Phuket with Blue Canyon, Red Mountain, and Aquella on 5- to 7-day Phuket golf getaways.

scorecard.gradeBadge: Jack Nicklaus Mangrove Ocean Frontage • Phuket
scorecard.verdict: Jack Nicklaus engineered several signature ocean holes playing directly over the azure waters of Phang Nga Bay and coastal mangrove flats. Stunning photography and island drama.

faqs.q: How close is Mission Hills Phuket to Phuket International Airport?
faqs.a: Just 12 to 15 minutes east of Phuket International Airport (HKT) — making it an effortless arrival-day or departure-day round alongside Blue Canyon.

faqs.q: What are the signature features of Mission Hills Phuket?
faqs.a: Jack Nicklaus framed the layout with massive, blinding-white coastal sand bunkers and scenic Andaman Sea vistas on the waterfront holes, particularly the ocean-edge par-3 4th.

faqs.q: How does Mission Hills Phuket compare to Red Mountain and Aquella?
faqs.a: Mission Hills is flatter and more open with strong coastal breezes; Red Mountain and Aquella offer sharper turf polish and wilder/newer architectural detail, so Mission Hills slots best as a 3rd or 4th round on a Phuket week.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play Mission Hills Phuket?
faqs.a: November through April is Phuket’s dry Andaman high season with sunny skies and steady sea breezes.
